name: China Northern Rare Earth (Group) High-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Northern Rare Earth (Group) High-Tech Co.,Ltd produces and sells rare earth raw materials in China, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. The company offers rare earth salts, rare earth oxides, and rare earth metals. It also provides rare earth functional material products, such as rare earth magnetic, polishing, hydrogen storage, and catalytic materials; and rare earth terminal application products comprising earth permanent magnet high-efficiency energy-saving motors. The company was formerly known as Inner Mongolia Baotou Steel Rare-Earth (Group) Hi-Tech Co., Ltd. and changed its name to China Northern Rare Earth (Group) High-Tech Co.,Ltd in January 2015. China Northern Rare Earth (Group) High-Tech Co.,Ltd was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Baotou, China.
